_comment: Filesystem version stamp (human semver). Hand-edited in lockstep with include/version.h's BLUEPAWZ_VERSION and committed once per release. The build-time git hash lives in the git-ignored data/build_info.json (generated by scripts/inject_git_hash.py) so it never dirties this tracked file. The /version endpoint serves fs_version (from here) + fs_git_hash (from build_info.json) side-by-side.
